package app

import "time"

type Todo struct {
	ID        string
	Title     string
	Done      bool
	Priority  int
	CreatedAt time.Time
	Tags      []string
}

type User struct {
	Name  string
	Todos []Todo
}

//loom:helper
func Upper(s string) string { return s }

//loom:helper
func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }
